trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Treat this as the capstone for the full set: the platinum arrives after every other trophy is recorded. Keep a separate checklist for story, activities, collectibles and optional encounters, then reconcile it with the in-game completion screens before stopping. The official requirement is simply the complete set; this note is a planning aid, not a substitute for checking each category. A roadmap such as PowerPyx’s and community tracking on PSNProfiles are useful cross-checks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through Gone Fishing to finish the opening mission and bank this story trophy. Follow the on-screen objectives rather than rushing through optional prompts, and let the mission transition complete before checking the trophy list. Because the game is new, confirm the exact mission flow in an official objective log or a spoiler-aware community roadmap; PowerPyx’s roadmap and PSNProfiles are sensible reference points.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 through its final story objective. Keep progressing the main mission markers until the chapter transition is clearly finished, then verify the unlock in the console trophy list. Chapter completion is a reliable backbone for the roadmap, while optional activities can be handled in a separate sweep. For route context, compare the game’s own mission list with a PowerPyx roadmap or PSNProfiles checklist.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 storyline to earn this chapter-clear trophy. Advance the main objectives in order and allow the final sequence to settle before leaving the area; check the trophy list afterward in case the unlock is delayed. Maintain a separate note of open activities so the chapter push does not bury them. Use PowerPyx’s roadmap and PSNProfiles as planning references, not as text to copy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: This marks completion of Chapter 3. Follow the main story markers until the game confirms the chapter change, then make sure the trophy registers before continuing. Side jobs need not interrupt the story route unless they appear time-sensitive in your own playthrough. A chapter-by-chapter roadmap from PowerPyx and a PSNProfiles checklist can help track what remains without relying on memory.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 4’s final story objective and confirm the bronze trophy appears. A clean chapter log makes it easier to see how far the main narrative has advanced and which optional strands still need attention. Avoid assuming a mission completion notification means the chapter trophy has registered; check the console list. Cross-reference the progression order with PowerPyx’s roadmap or PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Reach and complete the final mission to earn this gold story trophy. Before committing to the finale, finish any activity or character strand you personally want to do first, then follow the mission prompts through the ending and verify the unlock. The official description does not state a branching condition, so do not assume a particular ending is required. Use a roadmap such as PowerPyx and the PSNProfiles trophy page to plan cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Follow the objective prompts through the full mission and wait for the completion state before switching activities. Record it in your story checklist, since named mission trophies are easy to confuse with chapter clears. For broader sequencing, compare the in-game mission list against PowerPyx’s roadmap or PSNProfiles’ trophy checklist.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist to claim this mission trophy. Stay with the active objective chain through the heist’s conclusion, then check that the trophy has registered before moving on. If you are planning a tidy run, keep mission-specific unlocks separate from chapter trophies so missing one is easy to spot. PowerPyx’s roadmap and PSNProfiles can serve as independent checklist references.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child’s Play from its mission start through the end-of-mission confirmation. Watch for any remaining objective marker rather than leaving as soon as the main action appears done, then verify the trophy in your list. Pair this with a simple story checklist to avoid revisiting completed missions unnecessarily. A PowerPyx roadmap or PSNProfiles checklist can help place it in the overall order.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Clear Headliners and let its full mission-complete transition play out. The unusual trophy title is tied to the named mission in the official description, so use the mission log to identify it rather than guessing from the title. Confirm the unlock afterward and mark it off your story list. For cross-checking, consult PowerPyx’s roadmap or the PSNProfiles list.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown to unlock this story trophy. Track the mission by its objective name in the mission list, finish the entire objective sequence and check the console list once control returns. A distinct mission checklist helps separate this from other similarly themed activities. Use PowerPyx’s roadmap or PSNProfiles as navigation aids if you need to confirm story placement.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory from its first objective through the final mission-complete state. The trophy description names the mission directly, so the safest approach is to follow the in-game mission log and verify the unlock afterward. Keep optional completion tasks in a separate checklist. PowerPyx’s roadmap and PSNProfiles can help you plan the story sequence and later cleanup.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This gold trophy calls for 100% completion, so treat it as a multi-category checklist rather than a single mission. Regularly review the game’s completion tracker, then clear the remaining required story, side activities and other counted tasks it identifies. Do not assume every trophy task contributes to the percentage. Community roadmaps such as PowerPyx and PSNProfiles are useful for interpreting categories; validate details against the live in-game counter.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Accumulate 250 completed stunts, logging progress as you go instead of trying to count from memory. Use safe, repeatable routes with a suitable vehicle and vary locations when a stunt fails to register; only count successful completion feedback. This is a long-form activity, so fold attempts into exploration and revisit the tracker periodically. PowerPyx’s roadmap and PSNProfiles are planning references for trophy cleanup.
trophies.missable_reason: Track stunt totals as you travel; missed opportunities can be revisited with suitable vehicles.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type at least once, using the game’s activity list as your checklist. Start one example of every distinct category and confirm it registers before moving on; repeating the same activity does not cover a missing type. Mark categories off immediately to avoid backtracking. A PowerPyx roadmap or PSNProfiles checklist can help identify the activity breadth, while the in-game tracker remains the final authority.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold every Shooting Range challenge, then verify the range menu shows the top medal for all entries. Improve one challenge at a time and focus on accuracy, target priority and controlled shots rather than speed alone. Return to any non-gold result until the full board is complete. Because this is a substantial set, record each result; use PowerPyx’s roadmap and PSNProfiles as cross-checks.
trophies.missable_reason: Return to every range challenge and improve each result to gold before wrapping up side content.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every listed location. Keep a venue-by-venue checklist, finish each race successfully and confirm its result before moving to the next marker; a single win does not cover the full set. If the route feels unfamiliar, learn the course on an early attempt and prioritize checkpoints over risky shortcuts. Use PowerPyx’s roadmap and PSNProfiles to track outstanding locations.
trophies.missable_reason: Visit each marked race location and record wins so no venue is overlooked.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, prioritizing distinct event names rather than replaying one favorite course. Record each first-time win and check the event board for a clear completed result before counting it. If a race is available in multiple variations, treat them as separate only when the game lists them as distinct events. Community guides such as PowerPyx and PSNProfiles can support a cleanup checklist.
trophies.missable_reason: Use the event list to win twenty distinct race entries, not repeated runs of one event.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge when the activity is available. Start the challenge through its in-game prompt, follow the fishing controls carefully and aim to meet the contest target before time expires. If the first attempt falls short, retry after learning the casting and reeling rhythm rather than assuming a missable trigger. Track the contact activity and consult PowerPyx or PSNProfiles for roadmap context.
trophies.missable_reason: Complete Cal’s fishing challenge when its contact activity becomes available.
